name: Wooden Churches of Southern Małopolska
description: Six small villages in southern Poland's Małopolska region, among them Haczów, Dębno and Lipnica Murowana, hold some of Europe's finest timber churches. Their walls are built from horizontally stacked logs, and their steep shingled roofs rise to slender steeples. Step inside and you'll find painted and carved interiors, with Gothic detail in the older churches and Baroque or Rococo flourishes in later ones.
